source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For now, let's remove the landing-page work from scope. On the creative side, the proposed price is too high, and we also do not supply raw footage or voiceover.

The successful ad I shared was produced by another freelancer for 4800/- per video. He is a subject-matter expert, but he is currently unreachable, which is why I am looking here instead.

Your scope would therefore need to cover everything: footage, voiceover, and script. Our counterproposal is 22k inr for 8 video ads, each 45sec long, delivered as 16 finished files.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

The first draft is attached for your review. It took a little longer than expected because I did not want to rush the work; both the visuals and voiceover needed to come together in an engaging, natural, and scroll-stopping way while remaining true to your reference style.

I also found that forcing the story into exactly 16 seconds made it feel rushed. To give the emotions, product reveal, and voiceover enough space, I extended the draft slightly to 22 seconds. I believe the added room creates a stronger, more natural viewing experience without losing the impact of a short-form ad.

Please share your feedback. I am happy to refine anything you would like changed, and I remain fully committed to making sure the final production satisfies you and achieves the outcome you envision.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports attaching a draft in which the visuals and voiceover had been assembled.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I have already sent you images for the 1st product. However, I do not have a proper image for the 2nd product, so use AI to create better pack shots for that one.

value_updates.second_product_pack_shot_source: AI-created by the freelancer because no proper client-supplied image is available

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Nikhil Rao,

For visibility, I’m attaching the now-locked script for the 45 second version. It follows your reference video beat for beat and features both products together exactly as requested.

The full sequence begins with the performance issue and loss of confidence, presents Saffron Grove Men's Vitality as the solution, moves to the diabetes reveal, then brings in Glucose Balance Softgels alongside it before closing on both products together.

Next, I’m moving into voice recording and the final edit.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completing and attaching the locked 45-second script before moving into voice recording and final editing.

routing_warnings.description: The distinction between live-action footage, avatars, static-image animation, and realistic AI-generated scenes primarily defines the visual-generation method.
The instruction to create testimonial material independently is more specifically about the testimonial-content Requirement.
The rejected script failed the required reference-derived messaging direction rather than the obligation for the freelancer to originate production inputs.
The complaint that the preview visibly looked AI-generated is a realism failure, not a failure of input-sourcing responsibility.
The instruction to include both products belongs primarily to the two-product presentation Requirement.
